# Pickfoo Mananthavady (pickfoo.in)

> Pickfoo is a hyperlocal food delivery platform operated by Pickfoo Private Limited.
> We launch first in Mananthavady, Wayanad, Kerala (PIN 670645), connecting local
> restaurants and diners with reliable last-mile delivery across the hills.

## Key facts

- Brand: Pickfoo / Pickfoo Mananthavady / Pickfoo Wayanad
- Legal entity: Pickfoo Private Limited
- Service area: Mananthavady (primary), Wayanad district, Kerala, India
- Website: https://www.pickfoo.in
- Contact: contact@pickfoo.in
- Restaurant partner portal: https://restaurant.pickfoo.in/
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/pickfoo/id6772687742
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pickfoo.store
- Smart download link (QR): https://www.pickfoo.in/app

Pickfoo is not related to the US company "PickFu".
